title: Original yarn and fur on the retained Benny model
short: The violet stripe shows more weave, but the added grain leaves Benny’s hat and coat visibly different from the artwork.
paragraphs: I sampled the pink coat, ribbed cuff and shaggy violet pom directly from the verified original Screen 06. The trial wraps that detail around the six existing materials. It leaves the yellow star and every mesh, fur-shell count, rig, animation and game camera intact. At the opening and on both hard turns all 3D mesh attributes, visible states and world transforms matched Claudia’s retained actor.

The new purple stripe has vertical ridges. The pale stripe looks mottled, the pom still lacks the original separated yarn tips, and the body fur still reads as fine parallel strands. A fixed native rectangle around Benny covers 349,250 pixels. Mean absolute RGB error against the original changed from 35.733 to 35.744 on a 0–255 scale. Every changed opening pixel falls within the rendered actor and a two-pixel antialias margin.

Claudia’s Screen 06 Benny measures 448 × 477 visible pixels at the approved camera. The original silhouette measures approximately 435 × 459, with soft boundaries. The cuff ends about 54 pixels lower in the game. The material test held these dimensions fixed. A fitted, properly scaled knit on the physical cuff is a stronger separate test than adding grain over all six surfaces.
watch: Inspect the beginning, the first crest release and the hard-right view at native resolution. Compare the ribbed cuff and yellow star on the original with the woven bands and star face in the two game versions. The two complete swims use 63 identical camera and gameplay states.
proposals: The fixed-scale crops of all five versions of Benny are in character-review. Only the original image in each pair is an approved target. The Screen 06 material pilot is preserved as a rejected study.
